text: Lyse is wholly owned by 15 municipalities, and the group's value creation goes back to the community, per Viking FK's own partner page for its main partner.
short: Lyse is wholly owned by 15 Norwegian municipalities.

source.name: Viking FK – Lyse partner page
source.quote: Lyse er heleid av 15 kommuner, og konsernets verdiskaping går tilbake til fellesskapet.
